title: Person emerging from a workspace illustration
slide_intent: Show how a recognizable interface can become the setting for a human gesture. A figure reaching across the panel edge gives a static communication tool a sense of presence.
strategic_value: Slack can connect its product to the person behind a message using a simplified conversation and an expressive figure.
demonstration: A maroon rail frames a waving figure. A pale conversation area holds portrait tiles and short gray shapes in place of text and attachments.
practical_value: Borrow only the interface landmarks needed to identify the scene, then give the figure’s gesture enough room to cross the interface boundary.

content_islands.name: Workspace silhouette
content_islands.spec: Center a large rounded window on a pale gray page. Define a dark top bar and maroon sidebar against a light conversation area.

content_islands.name: Human figure
content_islands.spec: Frame the person in a sidebar compartment and extend the waving arm beyond the window edge.

content_islands.name: Conversation rows
content_islands.spec: Stack small portraits and abstract gray message shapes at right. Leave one larger pale rectangle to indicate an attachment or content block.
